Class PklValues

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pkl.env.PklValues
public final class PklValues extends Object
Converts the values of an evaluated Pkl module into the plain Java values a Micronaut PropertySource holds.

Objects and mappings become Maps, listings become Lists, a Duration becomes the short string form Micronaut's conversion service parses (for example 30s or 5m) and a DataSize becomes its exact number of bytes. null values are kept so that nested maps are flattened consistently; hidden members never reach this class because Pkl omits them from the exported object.

Since:
1.0.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    • flatten

      public static Map<String,Object> flatten(Map<String,Object> nested)
      Flattens nested maps into dotted property keys, in the same way the other Micronaut configuration loaders do: a map becomes a prefix and a non-null value a property. Null values and empty objects produce no keys, so an untouched property of a typed schema does not reach the Environment.
      Parameters:
      nested - The nested maps
      Returns:
      The flattened properties

    • toDurationString

      public static String toDurationString(org.pkl.core.Duration duration)
      Renders a Pkl duration in the short form Micronaut's conversion service accepts: an integer followed by ns, us, ms, s, m, h or d. A fractional amount is expressed in the next smaller unit until it is whole; an amount that does not fit the short form falls back to the ISO-8601 representation, which Micronaut also parses.
      Parameters:
      duration - The duration
      Returns:
      The string form
